questions.question: What types of fish does AZAFCO export?
questions.answer: We export Nile Tilapia, Sea Bass, Mullet (Bouri), Mubarakah, Catfish, Buni, Lout, and Eels. Additional products are available upon request. All products are ISO and HACCP certified.

questions.question: Which countries do you export to?
questions.answer: We currently export to Kuwait (our largest market), UAE, Qatar, Iraq, Bahrain, and Lebanon. We have EU export approval and can ship worldwide via air and land. Contact us to discuss exporting to your country.

questions.question: What quality certifications do you have?
questions.answer: We hold ISO 22000, HACCP, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications. We are one of only 6 Egyptian factories authorized to export to the European Union.

questions.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
questions.answer: Our minimum order is 1 carton. We handle wholesale B2B orders and offer flexible quantities to meet your specific requirements.

questions.question: How are the fish shipped?
questions.answer: We use a complete cold chain with refrigerated containers maintaining 0-4°C throughout transport. Fish are packed in EPS boxes to ensure they arrive fresh.

questions.question: Can you customize fish sizes for my order?
questions.answer: Yes! We offer great flexibility in sizes. All products can be customized to your specific requirements. Contact us to discuss your exact size needs.

questions.question: What are your working hours?
questions.answer: We operate 24/7 to serve our international clients across different time zones. You can reach us anytime via WhatsApp at +20-100-7736419.

questions.question: How much fish do you export monthly?
questions.answer: We export over 2,500 tons of fresh fish monthly to 8 countries. Kuwait receives +650 tons, UAE +400 tons, Qatar +350 tons, Iraq +175 tons, and Bahrain +100 tons.

questions.question: How long has AZAFCO been in business?
questions.answer: AZAFCO International was founded in 2008 in Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt. We have over 17 years of experience and serve +500 clients with +300 employees.

questions.question: What payment terms do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer competitive wholesale pricing with flexible payment terms. Contact us to discuss terms that work for your business needs.

questions.question: How do you ensure freshness during transport?
questions.answer: Our complete cold chain maintains 0-4°C from processing to delivery. We use refrigerated containers and EPS packaging. Fresh fish arrives fresh - guaranteed.

questions.question: Do you supply restaurants and hotels?
questions.answer: Yes! We serve distributors, restaurants of all sizes, hotels, catering companies, and supermarket chains across the Gulf region and internationally.
